title: Cash-or-nothing call and put, per-contract closed form
deliverables: summary json: parity residual con_c + con_p - Q e^{-rT}
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, cash Q per contract [M]. DITANYAKAN: CoN call and put value [M] (currency); parity residual. RUMUS: card Core 1; d2 = [ln(S/K) + (r - q - sigma^2/2)T]/(sigma sqrt T); call = Q e^{-rT} N(d2), put = Q e^{-rT} N(-d2); toolkit digital_price(S,K,T,r,sigma,kind,payoff='cash',q,cash=Q). JAWAB: 1) read [M] rows, percent -> decimal. 2) d2 [M]. 3) call, put [M] scaled by Q. 4) residual call + put - Q e^{-rT} [M], max abs ~1e-12. 5) write table + summary.
pitfalls: d2 uses b = r - q, not r; payout Q multiplies, not adds

title: Asset-or-nothing call and put, vanilla decomposition
deliverables: per-contract table: aon_call, aon_put, con_call, bs_call
summary json: max |AoN_c - K CoN_c - C_BS|
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: AoN call/put [M] (currency); check vanilla = AoN - K CoN. RUMUS: card Core 1; d1 = d2 + sigma sqrt T; AoN_c = S e^{-qT} N(d1), AoN_p = S e^{-qT} N(-d1); toolkit digital_price(...payoff='asset'), bs_price. JAWAB: 1) d1, d2 [M]. 2) AoN_c, AoN_p [M]. 3) CoN_c (unit cash) [M]. 4) C_BS via bs_price [M]. 5) residuals AoN_c - K CoN_c - C_BS and AoN_c + AoN_p - S e^{-qT}. 6) write.
pitfalls: forgetting e^{-qT} on the asset leg

title: Gap call with separate trigger and strike
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K1 (payment strike), K2 (trigger), T, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: gap call value [M]; may be negative when K1 > K2. RUMUS: card Core 1; d1 = [ln(S/K2) + (r - q + sigma^2/2)T]/(sigma sqrt T), d2 = d1 - sigma sqrt T; gap_c = S e^{-qT} N(d1) - K1 e^{-rT} N(d2). JAWAB: 1) identify which strike is the trigger (payoff condition S_T > K2). 2) d1, d2 on K2 [M]. 3) price [M]. 4) check: set K1 = K2 -> bs_price call; gap = AoN(K2) - K1 CoN(K2). 5) write.
formulas: gap_c = S e^{-qT} N(d1(K2)) - K1 e^{-rT} N(d2(K2))
pitfalls: d1, d2 computed on K1 instead of the trigger K2
clipping a negative gap value to zero

title: Gap put with trigger below payment strike
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K1 payment strike, K2 trigger, T, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: gap put value [M] (currency): pays K1 - S_T if S_T < K2. RUMUS: d1, d2 on K2; gap_p = K1 e^{-rT} N(-d2) - S e^{-qT} N(-d1). Decomposition K1 CoN_p(K2) - AoN_p(K2); toolkit digital_price, bs_price. JAWAB: 1) inputs [M]. 2) d1, d2 [M] with K2. 3) gap put [M]. 4) gap call - gap put = S e^{-qT} - K1 e^{-rT} (same K1, K2) residual. 5) K1 = K2 vs bs_price put. 6) write.
formulas: gap_p = K1 e^{-rT} N(-d2) - S e^{-qT} N(-d1)
gap_c - gap_p = S e^{-qT} - K1 e^{-rT}

title: Digital option Monte Carlo vs closed form with standard error
deliverables: summary json: closed_form, mc_price, standard_error, z_score, agrees
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, cash Q; n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC price, SE (currency), agreement with closed form. RUMUS: S_T = S exp((r - q - sigma^2/2)T + sigma sqrt T Z); payoff Q 1{S_T > K} (call) [n_paths]; price = e^{-rT} mean; SE = std(disc payoff, ddof=1)/sqrt N; toolkit digital_price, gbm_paths(n_steps=1). JAWAB: 1) rng = default_rng(seed), Z [n_paths]. 2) S_T [n_paths]. 3) discounted indicator payoffs. 4) price, SE scalars. 5) z = (mc - cf)/SE, agrees = |z| <= 3. 6) write.
pitfalls: SE on undiscounted payoffs

title: Digital replication by tight call spread
deliverables: table by width eps: spread_price, digital_price, error
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma; list of widths eps [W]. DITANYAKAN: price of (C(K - eps) - C(K))/eps or centred (C(K-eps/2) - C(K+eps/2))/eps per width [W]; error vs CoN_c. RUMUS: CoN_c = -dC/dK = e^{-rT} N(d2); call spread from bs_price; toolkit bs_price, digital_price. JAWAB: 1) for each eps compute spread price [W]. 2) closed-form digital scalar. 3) error [W]; one-sided spread over-replicates (super-hedge), error O(eps); centred O(eps^2). 4) write table.
pitfalls: using undiscounted N(d2) as dC/dK

title: Digital option Greeks: delta, gamma, vega
deliverables: per-contract table: price, delta, gamma, vega
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma [M] (cash digital, unit pay). DITANYAKAN: price, delta (per unit S), gamma, vega (per 1.00 vol) [M]. RUMUS: V = e^{-rT} N(d2); delta = e^{-rT} n(d2)/(S sigma sqrt T); gamma = -e^{-rT} n(d2) d1/(S^2 sigma^2 T); vega = -e^{-rT} n(d2) d1/sigma. JAWAB: 1) d1, d2 [M]. 2) closed-form Greeks [M]. 3) cross-check by central bumps h = 1% of S/sigma on digital_price. 4) note spike as T -> 0 near K (pin risk). 5) rescale vega per vol point if asked (/100). 6) write.
formulas: delta = e^{-rT} n(d2)/(S sigma sqrt T)
pitfalls: vega sign: positive only when d1 < 0 (OTM digital call)

title: Down-and-out call, strike above barrier, closed form
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, X, H < S, H < X, T, r, q, sigma, rebate R (default 0) [M]. DITANYAKAN: DO call value [M] (currency). RUMUS: card Core 2: mu, lam, v; A, C, F terms; DOc(X>H) = A - C + F; toolkit barrier_price(S,K,H,T,r,sigma,kind='call',barrier='down-and-out',q,rebate). JAWAB: 1) check S > H (else knocked: value = rebate). 2) b = r - q, mu, lam, v [M]. 3) x1, y1, z [M]; A, C, F with phi = +1, eta = +1. 4) DOc [M]. 5) check 0 <= DOc <= bs_price call. 6) write.
formulas: A = S e^{(b-r)T} N(x1) - X e^{-rT} N(x1 - v)
pitfalls: using X<H branch formulas when X>H

title: Down-and-in call via in-out parity and direct formula
frame: DIKETAHUI: S > H, X, T, r, q, sigma [M]; no rebate. DITANYAKAN: DI call [M]; parity residual. RUMUS: card Core 2: X>H DIc = C + E; X<H DIc = A - B + D + E; DI + DO = vanilla (R = 0); toolkit barrier_price(barrier='down-and-in'), bs_price. JAWAB: 1) branch on X vs H per row. 2) compute A..F terms [M]. 3) DI direct [M]. 4) DO companion [M]. 5) vanilla [M]. 6) residual DI + DO - vanilla [M] ~1e-12. 7) write.
pitfalls: parity fails with a rebate: KI rebate paid at expiry, KO rebate at hit

title: Up-and-out call, barrier above strike
frame: DIKETAHUI: S < H, X < H, T, r, q, sigma, rebate R [M]. DITANYAKAN: UO call [M] (and UI companion). RUMUS: card Core 2 with phi = +1, eta = -1: UOc(X<H) = A - B + C - D + F; UIc(X<H) = B - C + D + E; X >= H: UOc = F (worthless apart from rebate). Toolkit barrier_price(barrier='up-and-out'). JAWAB: 1) check S < H. 2) terms A..F [M], eta = -1. 3) UO, UI [M]. 4) UO + UI = vanilla (R = 0). 5) bounds 0 <= UO <= vanilla; UO <= (H - X) e^{-rT}-ish cap. 6) write.
formulas: UOc(X<H) = A - B + C - D + F
pitfalls: eta sign: -1 for up barriers

title: Up-and-in and up-and-out puts
deliverables: per-contract table: ui_put, uo_put, bs_put, parity_residual
frame: DIKETAHUI: S < H, X, T, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: UI put, UO put [M] (currency). RUMUS: card Core 2, phi = -1, eta = -1; X>H: UIp = A - B + D + E, UOp = B - D + F; X<H: UIp = C + E, UOp = A - C + F. Toolkit barrier_price(kind='put', barrier='up-and-in'/'up-and-out'). JAWAB: 1) branch X vs H. 2) terms with phi = eta = -1 [M]. 3) UIp, UOp [M]. 4) UIp + UOp - bs_price put [M]. 5) write.

title: Down-and-out and down-and-in puts
frame: DIKETAHUI: S > H, X, T, r, q, sigma, rebate [M]. DITANYAKAN: DO/DI put [M]. RUMUS: card Core 2, phi = -1, eta = +1; X>H: DIp = B - C + D + E, DOp = A - B + C - D + F; X<H: DIp = A + E, DOp = F (the put pays only below X < H, already knocked). Toolkit barrier_price(kind='put'). JAWAB: 1) branch. 2) A..F [M]. 3) DO, DI [M]. 4) DI + DO = bs put (R = 0). 5) DOp <= vanilla, >= 0. 6) write.
formulas: X>H: DOp = A - B + C - D + F
pitfalls: DO put with X<H has no value beyond the rebate

title: Knock-out barrier with rebate paid at hit
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma, rebate R [M]; rebate on knock-out paid at hit (default). DITANYAKAN: KO price with rebate [M]; rebate component. RUMUS: card Core 2: F = R[(H/S)^{mu+lam} N(eta z) + (H/S)^{mu-lam} N(eta z - 2 eta lam v)], z = ln(H/S)/v + lam v; KO = (R = 0 terms) + F. Toolkit barrier_price(rebate=R). JAWAB: 1) price with R = 0 [M]. 2) F term [M] = PV of R paid at first passage. 3) total [M]. 4) check F <= R; F/R relates to discounted hit probability. 5) write.
formulas: F = R[(H/S)^{mu+lam} N(eta z) + (H/S)^{mu-lam} N(eta z - 2 eta lam v)]
pitfalls: rebate paid at expiry instead: use R e^{-rT} P(hit) (E-type term)

title: Knock-in barrier with rebate paid at expiry if never hit
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma, rebate R [M]; KI rebate paid at T if barrier never touched. DITANYAKAN: KI price incl. rebate [M]. RUMUS: card Core 2: E = R e^{-rT}[N(eta x2 - eta v) - (H/S)^{2mu} N(eta y2 - eta v)] = R e^{-rT} P(no hit); DIc(X>H) = C + E etc. JAWAB: 1) x2, y2 [M]. 2) E [M]. 3) KI = option terms + E. 4) check E/(R e^{-rT}) in [0,1] equals survival probability from barrier_hit_prob (1 - hit). 5) write.
formulas: E = R e^{-rT}[N(eta x2 - eta v) - (H/S)^{2mu} N(eta y2 - eta v)]

title: Barrier option Monte Carlo with discrete monitoring vs continuous closed form
deliverables: per-contract table: closed_form, mc_price, standard_error, bias
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma [M]; n_paths, n_steps, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC price, SE [M]; difference vs continuous closed form. RUMUS: gbm_paths(S, r - q, sigma, T, n_steps, n_paths, seed) [n_paths x n_steps+1]; alive = all(S_j > H) over monitoring dates; payoff = alive x max(S_T - X, 0); SE = std(ddof=1)/sqrt N; closed form barrier_price. JAWAB: 1) paths once, reuse for all contracts with same T. 2) knock indicator [n_paths]. 3) disc payoff -> price, SE [M]. 4) bias = mc - cf; discrete DO > continuous DO. 5) write.
pitfalls: comparing discrete MC to continuous formula and calling the gap MC error

title: Broadie-Glasserman-Kou continuity correction for discrete barriers
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma [M]; monitoring interval dt = T/m. DITANYAKAN: approx discrete-monitored barrier price [M]. RUMUS: card Core 2 BGK: down H' = H e^{-0.5826 sigma sqrt dt}, up H' = H e^{+0.5826 sigma sqrt dt}; price = continuous formula at H'; toolkit bgk_shift(H, S0, sigma, dt), barrier_price. JAWAB: 1) dt from monitoring frequency (daily = 1/252 or T/n). 2) shifted barrier [M]. 3) continuous closed form at H' [M]. 4) compare with discrete MC within SE. 5) write.
pitfalls: shifting the wrong direction (down barrier must move further from spot)

title: Brownian-bridge corrected Monte Carlo for continuous barrier
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma; n_paths, n_steps, seed. DITANYAKAN: continuous-barrier price by MC with bridge correction, SE. RUMUS: per step with log levels x_i, x_{i+1}, h = ln H: down crossing prob p_i = exp(-2 (x_i - h)(x_{i+1} - h)/(sigma^2 dt)) if both above h; survival = prod(1 - p_i); payoff = survival x max(S_T - X, 0). JAWAB: 1) log paths [n_paths x n_steps+1]. 2) p_i [n_paths x n_steps]. 3) survival weight [n_paths] (0 if any node below h). 4) disc payoff, price, SE. 5) compare to barrier_price; bias vanishes. 6) write.

title: Barrier hit probability and first-passage time
frame: DIKETAHUI: S0, H, T, drift mu (log or arithmetic), sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: P(hit H by T) in [0,1] [M]; survival = 1 - hit; optional E[tau]. RUMUS: log barrier b = ln(H/S0), nu = mu - sigma^2/2 if arithmetic drift; down: P = N((b - nu T)/(sigma sqrt T)) + e^{2 nu b/sigma^2} N((b + nu T)/(sigma sqrt T)); toolkit barrier_hit_prob(S0,H,T,mu,sigma,drift_is_log), first_passage_cdf, expected_first_passage_time, mc_hit_probability. JAWAB: 1) decide drift convention. 2) closed-form P [M]. 3) MC check with paths, first_hit_times. 4) hit + survive = 1. 5) write.
formulas: P_down = N((b - nu T)/(s sqrt T)) + e^{2 nu b/s^2} N((b + nu T)/(s sqrt T))
E[tau] = |b|/|nu| when nu points toward barrier
pitfalls: mixing mu and nu = mu - sigma^2/2

title: One-touch and no-touch digitals
deliverables: summary json: OT(expiry) + NT - Q e^{-rT}
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, H, T, r, q, sigma, cash Q [M]; payment at hit or at expiry. DITANYAKAN: one-touch and no-touch values [M] (currency). RUMUS: pay at hit = F-term of card Core 2 with R = Q (Haug American cash-or-nothing); pay at expiry = Q e^{-rT} P_Q(hit); NT = Q e^{-rT} - OT_expiry. Toolkit one_touch_price(S,H,T,r,sigma,q,cash,pay_at), no_touch_price. JAWAB: 1) barrier side (up if H > S). 2) OT [M] by timing. 3) NT [M]. 4) check OT_hit >= OT_expiry (r > 0), NT + OT_expiry = Q e^{-rT}. 5) write.
formulas: OT_hit = Q[(H/S)^{mu+lam} N(eta z) + (H/S)^{mu-lam} N(eta z - 2 eta lam v)]
pitfalls: using real-world drift instead of r - q for the risk-neutral hit probability

title: Cash digital down-and-out call and up-and-out cash put
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma [M]; unit cash at T. DITANYAKAN: DO cash call (X>H) or UO cash put (X<H) [M]. RUMUS: card Core 2: DO cash call = e^{-rT}[N(d2) - (H/S)^{2mu} N(d2_H)], d2_H = [ln(H^2/(SX)) + (b - sigma^2/2)T]/v; UO cash put = e^{-rT}[N(-d2) - (H/S)^{2mu} N(-d2_H)]; 2mu = 2b/sigma^2 - 1. JAWAB: 1) branch product. 2) d2, d2_H [M]. 3) price [M]. 4) check 0 <= price <= plain digital_price; DO digital + DI digital = plain. 5) write.

title: Barrier contracts with spot already through the barrier or invalid side
frame: DIKETAHUI: barrier contracts [M] with kind labels (down/up, in/out), S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma, rebate. DITANYAKAN: price per row [M] with correct handling when S already breached H. RUMUS: down barrier requires S > H, up requires S < H; breached KO -> value = rebate (paid now); breached KI -> vanilla bs_price; else barrier_price. JAWAB: 1) normalise labels (DO, DI, UO, UI, call/put). 2) status per row: alive / knocked. 3) price by branch [M]. 4) flag inconsistent label/side rows. 5) check KI + KO = vanilla on alive rows. 6) write.
formulas: S <= H (down): KO = R, KI = vanilla
S >= H (up): KO = R, KI = vanilla
pitfalls: feeding a breached barrier into the closed form gives garbage

title: Barrier option Greeks by bump-and-revalue
deliverables: per-contract table: price, delta, gamma, vega
frame: DIKETAHUI: barrier contracts S, X, H, T, r, q, sigma [M]; bump sizes h_S, h_sigma. DITANYAKAN: delta, gamma, vega [M] of barrier price. RUMUS: central differences on barrier_price: delta = (V(S+h) - V(S-h))/2h, gamma = (V(S+h) - 2V + V(S-h))/h^2, vega = (V(sigma+h) - V(sigma-h))/2h. JAWAB: 1) h = 1% of S (smaller near barrier, keep S-h > H). 2) bumped prices [M]. 3) Greeks [M]. 4) note DO call delta can exceed vanilla near H, gamma negative near barrier for UO call. 5) rescale vega per vol point if asked. 6) write.
pitfalls: bump crossing the barrier

title: Floating-strike lookback call (Goldman-Sosin-Gatto)
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, T, r, q, sigma, observed min m (default m = S) [M]. DITANYAKAN: float call paying S_T - min S [M]. RUMUS: card Core 3: b = r - q, a1 = [ln(S/m) + (b + sigma^2/2)T]/v, a2 = a1 - v; c = S e^{-qT}N(a1) - m e^{-rT}N(a2) + S e^{-rT}(sigma^2/2b)[(S/m)^{-2b/sigma^2} N(-a1 + 2b sqrt T/sigma) - e^{bT}N(-a1)]; toolkit lookback_floating_price(S,T,r,sigma,kind='call',q,s_min). JAWAB: 1) b; if b = 0 use small b. 2) a1, a2 [M]. 3) price [M]. 4) check >= ATM vanilla bs_price(K = m). 5) write.
pitfalls: b = 0 division by zero

title: Floating-strike lookback put
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, T, r, q, sigma, observed max M (default S) [M]. DITANYAKAN: float put paying max S - S_T [M]. RUMUS: card Core 3: b1 = [ln(S/M) + (b + sigma^2/2)T]/v, b2 = b1 - v; p = M e^{-rT}N(-b2) - S e^{-qT}N(-b1) + S e^{-rT}(sigma^2/2b)[e^{bT}N(b1) - (S/M)^{-2b/sigma^2} N(b1 - 2b sqrt T/sigma)]; toolkit lookback_floating_price(kind='put', s_max). JAWAB: 1) b, M. 2) b1, b2 [M]. 3) price [M]. 4) check >= bs_price put (K = M). 5) write.
formulas: p = M e^{-rT}N(-b2) - S e^{-qT}N(-b1) + S e^{-rT}(s^2/2b)[e^{bT}N(b1) - (S/M)^{-2b/s^2}N(b1 - 2b sqrt T/s)]

title: Fixed-strike lookback call (Conze-Viswanathan)
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, running max M (default S) [M]. DITANYAKAN: call on max: max(M_T - K, 0) [M]. RUMUS: card Core 3: K > M: S e^{-qT}N(d1) - K e^{-rT}N(d2) + S e^{-rT}(sigma^2/2b)[e^{bT}N(d1) - (S/K)^{-2b/sigma^2}N(d1 - 2b sqrt T/sigma)]; K <= M: e^{-rT}(M - K) + same with K -> M. Toolkit lookback_fixed_price(S,K,T,r,sigma,kind='call',q,s_max). JAWAB: 1) branch on K vs M [M]. 2) d1, d2 on K or M. 3) price [M]. 4) check >= vanilla call; identity fixed call(K=S) - float put = S e^{-qT} - S e^{-rT}. 5) write.
formulas: K <= M: e^{-rT}(M - K) + C_LB(K -> M)
fixed call(K=S) - float put = S e^{-qT} - S e^{-rT}

title: Fixed-strike lookback put on the minimum
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, running min m (default S) [M]. DITANYAKAN: put paying max(K - min S, 0) [M]. RUMUS: K < m: K e^{-rT}N(-d2) - S e^{-qT}N(-d1) + S e^{-rT}(sigma^2/2b)[(S/K)^{-2b/sigma^2}N(-d1 + 2b sqrt T/sigma) - e^{bT}N(-d1)]; K >= m: e^{-rT}(K - m) + same with K -> m. Toolkit lookback_fixed_price(kind='put', s_min). JAWAB: 1) branch [M]. 2) d1, d2. 3) price [M]. 4) check >= vanilla put; fixed put(K=S) - float call = S e^{-rT} - S e^{-qT}. 5) write.
formulas: K >= m: e^{-rT}(K - m) + P_LB(K -> m)

title: Lookback Monte Carlo with discrete monitoring bias and bridge maximum
deliverables: summary json: closed_form, mc_raw, mc_bridge, se_raw, se_bridge
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K (or floating), T, r, q, sigma; n_paths, n_steps, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC lookback price and SE; bias vs continuous formula. RUMUS: gbm_paths -> running_max_path / running_extremes; bridge max per step x_max = (x_i + x_{i+1} + sqrt((x_{i+1} - x_i)^2 - 2 sigma^2 dt ln U))/2, U ~ U(0,1); payoff on max over steps. JAWAB: 1) log paths [n_paths x n_steps+1]. 2) raw max (grid) [n_paths]. 3) bridge max: sample per step, take max. 4) disc payoffs, price, SE for both. 5) raw underprices floating put / fixed call; bridge close to lookback_floating_price/lookback_fixed_price. 6) write.
formulas: x_max = (x_i + x_{i+1} + sqrt((x_{i+1}-x_i)^2 - 2 s^2 dt ln U))/2
pitfalls: daily-grid max biased low vs continuous closed form

title: Partial-time or seasoned lookback with observed extreme
frame: DIKETAHUI: S today, remaining T, r, q, sigma, extremes observed so far (s_min, s_max) [M]. DITANYAKAN: current value of float/fixed lookback [M]. RUMUS: card Core 3 with m = observed min, M = observed max (not S); toolkit lookback_floating_price(s_min/s_max), lookback_fixed_price(s_max/s_min). JAWAB: 1) take extremes from history (inclusive of today). 2) remaining T in years. 3) price with observed extremes [M]. 4) compare to fresh (m = M = S) to show seasoned value larger for in-the-money extremes. 5) write.
pitfalls: resetting m to S on a seasoned contract

title: Discrete geometric average Asian, closed form
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, n fixings t_i = iT/n [M]. DITANYAKAN: geometric Asian call/put [M] (currency). RUMUS: card Core 4: Mu = (b - sigma^2/2)T(n+1)/(2n), H = sigma^2 T(n+1)(2n+1)/(6n^2); F_G = S e^{Mu + H/2}; call = e^{-rT}[F_G N(d1) - K N(d2)], d1 = [ln(F_G/K) + H/2]/sqrt H, d2 = d1 - sqrt H; toolkit asian_geometric_price(S,K,T,r,sigma,kind,q,n,include_t0=False). JAWAB: 1) n, dates (exclude t0). 2) Mu, H [M]. 3) call/put [M]. 4) check geo < vanilla, put-call: c - p = e^{-rT}(F_G - K). 5) write.
pitfalls: including S0 changes n+1 terms

title: Continuous geometric Asian with adjusted vol and carry
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma [M]; continuous average over [0,T]. DITANYAKAN: continuous geometric Asian price [M]. RUMUS: card Core 4: sigma_G = sigma/sqrt 3, b_G = (b - sigma^2/6)/2; price = generalised BS with carry b_G: S e^{(b_G - r)T}N(d1) - K e^{-rT}N(d2), d1 = [ln(S/K) + (b_G + sigma_G^2/2)T]/(sigma_G sqrt T). JAWAB: 1) b = r - q. 2) sigma_G, b_G. 3) price [M]. 4) check: discrete formula with n large -> continuous. 5) write.

title: Arithmetic Asian by Levy lognormal moment matching
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, n fixings [M]. DITANYAKAN: arithmetic Asian price by Levy [M]. RUMUS: card Core 4: M1 = (S/n) sum e^{b t_i}; M2 = (S^2/n^2) sum_ij e^{b(t_i + t_j) + sigma^2 min(t_i,t_j)}; v^2 = ln(M2/M1^2); call = e^{-rT}[M1 N(d1) - K N(d2)], d1 = [ln(M1/K) + v^2/2]/v; toolkit asian_arithmetic_levy(S,K,T,r,sigma,kind,q,n,include_t0). JAWAB: 1) dates t_i [n]. 2) M1, M2 (double sum [n x n]). 3) v, d1, d2 [M]. 4) price [M]. 5) check levy >= asian_geometric_price, < vanilla. 6) write.

title: Arithmetic Asian by Turnbull-Wakeman continuous moments
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma [M]; continuous averaging (optionally from tau to T). DITANYAKAN: TW approx price [M]. RUMUS: b = r - q; M1 = (e^{bT} - 1)/(bT); M2 = 2 e^{(2b + sigma^2)T}/((b + sigma^2)(2b + sigma^2)T^2) + 2/(bT^2)[1/(2b + sigma^2) - e^{bT}/(b + sigma^2)]; b_A = ln(M1)/T, sigma_A^2 = ln(M2)/T - 2 b_A; generalised BS with b_A, sigma_A. JAWAB: 1) M1, M2 [M] (b -> 0 limits). 2) b_A, sigma_A. 3) price [M]. 4) compare with Levy at large n. 5) write.
pitfalls: b = 0 limit needs series forms

title: Arithmetic Asian by Curran conditioning approximation
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, n fixings [M]. DITANYAKAN: Curran price [M]. RUMUS: card Core 4: mu_i = ln S + (b - sigma^2/2)t_i, s_i^2 = sigma^2 t_i, mu = mean mu_i, s_x^2 = (sigma^2/n^2) sum_ij min(t_i,t_j), s_xi = (sigma^2/n) sum_j min(t_i,t_j); K^ = 2K - (1/n) sum_i exp(mu_i + s_xi(ln K - mu)/s_x^2 + (s_i^2 - s_xi^2/s_x^2)/2); call = e^{-rT}[(1/n) sum_i e^{mu_i + s_i^2/2} N((mu - ln K^)/s_x + s_xi/s_x) - K N((mu - ln K^)/s_x)]; toolkit asian_curran. JAWAB: 1) dates. 2) vectors mu_i, s_xi [n]. 3) K^. 4) price [M]. 5) compare Levy, MC. 6) write.
formulas: K^ = 2K - (1/n) sum exp(mu_i + s_xi (ln K - mu)/s_x^2 + (s_i^2 - s_xi^2/s_x^2)/2)
pitfalls: K^ <= 0 when K small: use linear threshold variant

title: Arithmetic Asian Monte Carlo with geometric control variate
deliverables: summary json: mc_plain, se_plain, mc_cv, se_cv, beta, variance_reduction
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, n fixings; n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: arithmetic Asian MC price, SE plain and with control variate. RUMUS: gbm_paths n_steps = n; A = mean(S_{t_1..t_n}), G = exp(mean ln S); Y = e^{-rT}(A - K)^+, X = e^{-rT}(G - K)^+, E[X] = asian_geometric_price; beta = Cov(Y,X)/Var(X); Y_cv = Y - beta(X - E[X]); SE = std(Y_cv, ddof=1)/sqrt N. JAWAB: 1) paths, drop column t0. 2) Y, X [n_paths]. 3) beta scalar. 4) price/SE both. 5) ratio Var(Y)/Var(Y_cv). 6) check cv price within SE of Levy/Curran. 7) write.
pitfalls: geometric average on dates differing from the arithmetic ones

title: Asian option with S0 included in the average
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, n; convention says average includes t0 = 0. DITANYAKAN: Asian price [M] under the stated date set. RUMUS: dates t_i = iT/n, i = 0..n (n+1 fixings, first deterministic = S); moments recomputed on that set; toolkit asian_geometric_price(..., include_t0=True), asian_arithmetic_levy(include_t0=True). JAWAB: 1) build date vector per convention. 2) moments M1, M2 or Mu, H on that vector. 3) price [M] both conventions. 4) including S0 lowers variance -> lower price for ATM. 5) write per stated convention.
formulas: Geo incl t0: Mu, H from t = 0..T, n+1 points
pitfalls: default is exclude t0, include T

title: Floating-strike (average strike) Asian by Monte Carlo
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, T, r, q, sigma, n fixings, k multiplier (default 1); n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: average-strike call max(S_T - k A, 0) (or put) MC price and SE. RUMUS: gbm_paths (antithetic optional); A = mean(S_{t_1..t_n}); payoff [n_paths]; price = e^{-rT} mean; SE = std(ddof=1)/sqrt N (antithetic: on pair averages). JAWAB: 1) rng seeded. 2) paths [n_paths x n+1]. 3) A [n_paths]. 4) payoffs, price, SE. 5) check 0 <= price <= S e^{-qT}; geometric version closed form for sanity. 6) write.

title: Forward-start ATM call
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, t_s (strike-setting date), tau (life after t_s), r, q, sigma, moneyness alpha (default 1) [M]. DITANYAKAN: value today [M]. RUMUS: card Core 5: K = alpha S_{t_s}; value = S e^{-q t_s} x BS(1, alpha, tau, r, q, sigma); ATM: S e^{-q t_s}[e^{-q tau}N(d1) - e^{-r tau}N(d2)], d1 = [ -ln alpha + (b + sigma^2/2)tau]/(sigma sqrt tau). Toolkit bs_price(S=1,K=alpha,T=tau). JAWAB: 1) t_s, tau in years. 2) unit-spot BS [M]. 3) scale by S e^{-q t_s}. 4) check q = 0: value = BS ATM today with T = tau. 5) write.
formulas: V = S e^{-q t_s} BS(1, alpha, tau)
pitfalls: discounting over t_s with r instead of q

title: Uncapped cliquet as sum of forward starts
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, reset dates 0 = t_0 < ... < t_n, r, q, sigma; payoff each period max(S_{t_i} - S_{t_{i-1}}, 0) (absolute) or relative return. DITANYAKAN: per-period values [n], total. RUMUS: card Core 5: period i value = S e^{-q t_{i-1}} BS(1, 1, t_i - t_{i-1}); relative-return payoff divides by S_{t_{i-1}}: = e^{-r t_{i-1}} BS(1,1,tau_i) x (S-free). JAWAB: 1) taus [n]. 2) per-period [n]. 3) sum. 4) check period 0 = vanilla ATM(tau_1); more resets -> larger (sqrt scaling). 5) write.
pitfalls: mixing absolute vs return payoffs

title: Capped and floored cliquet by Monte Carlo
frame: DIKETAHUI: notional N, S, reset dates [n], r, q, sigma, local cap c, local floor f, global floor F_g (optional); n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC price, SE. RUMUS: R_i = S_{t_i}/S_{t_{i-1}} - 1 from exact GBM per period; payoff = N max(F_g, sum_i min(max(R_i, f), c)) at T; price = e^{-rT} mean; SE = std(ddof=1)/sqrt N. JAWAB: 1) simulate period returns [n_paths x n]. 2) clip each. 3) sum, global floor/cap [n_paths]. 4) price, SE. 5) check f = 0, c = inf, no global floor -> sum of forward starts closed form. 6) write.
formulas: payoff = N max(F_g, sum_i clip(R_i, f, c))

title: Geske call on call
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K1 (compound strike, paid at T1), K2 (inner strike), T1 < T2, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: CoC value [M]; critical S*. RUMUS: card Core 6: rho = sqrt(T1/T2); S* solves BS_call(S*, K2, T2 - T1) = K1 (geske_critical_price); y1, y2 at (S*, T1); z1, z2 = d1, d2 at (K2, T2); CoC = S e^{-qT2} M(z1,y1;rho) - K2 e^{-rT2} M(z2,y2;rho) - K1 e^{-rT1} N(y2). Toolkit compound_option_price(kind='call_on_call'), bivariate_normal_cdf. JAWAB: 1) S* by root find [M]. 2) y, z [M]. 3) CoC [M]. 4) check 0 <= CoC <= C_BS(K2,T2). 5) write.
formulas: CoC = S e^{-qT2} M(z1,y1;rho) - K2 e^{-rT2} M(z2,y2;rho) - K1 e^{-rT1} N(y2)

title: Compound option parity: call-on-call vs put-on-call
deliverables: per-contract table: coc, poc, parity_lhs, parity_rhs, residual
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K1, K2, T1, T2, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: CoC, PoC [M]; parity residual. RUMUS: card Core 6: PoC = K2 e^{-rT2} M(z2,-y2;-rho) - S e^{-qT2} M(z1,-y1;-rho) + K1 e^{-rT1} N(-y2); parity CoC - PoC = C_BS(K2,T2) - K1 e^{-rT1}; toolkit compound_option_price, compound_parity_rhs(inner='call'). JAWAB: 1) S* (inner call). 2) CoC, PoC [M]. 3) rhs [M]. 4) residual [M] ~1e-10. 5) write.
pitfalls: pairing CoC with PoP (different inner option) for parity

title: Compound options on a put: call-on-put and put-on-put
deliverables: per-contract table: s_star, cop, pop, parity_residual
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K1, K2, T1, T2, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: CoP, PoP [M]; parity CoP - PoP = P_BS(K2,T2) - K1 e^{-rT1}. RUMUS: S* solves P_BS(S*, K2, T2 - T1) = K1 (inner put; outer put exercised when S_T1 > S*); PoP = S e^{-qT2} M(-z1,y1;-rho) - K2 e^{-rT2} M(-z2,y2;-rho) + K1 e^{-rT1} N(y2); CoP = K2 e^{-rT2} M(-z2,-y2;rho) - S e^{-qT2} M(-z1,-y1;rho) - K1 e^{-rT1} N(-y2). Toolkit compound_option_price(kind='put_on_put'/'call_on_put'). JAWAB: 1) S* for put. 2) both prices [M]. 3) parity residual. 4) write.
pitfalls: outer put on put exercised when S_T1 > S*, not below

title: Compound option Monte Carlo validation
deliverables: summary json: closed_form, mc_price, standard_error, agrees
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K1, K2, T1, T2, r, q, sigma, kind; n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC compound price and SE vs Geske. RUMUS: S_T1 exact GBM [n_paths]; inner value at T1 = bs_price(S_T1, K2, T2 - T1) (analytic, no nested paths); outer payoff max(V - K1, 0) call or max(K1 - V, 0) put; price = e^{-rT1} mean; SE ddof=1; toolkit compound_option_mc, compound_option_price. JAWAB: 1) Z [n_paths], S_T1. 2) inner BS [n_paths]. 3) payoff. 4) price, SE. 5) |mc - cf| <= 3 SE. 6) write.
pitfalls: discounting over T2 instead of T1

title: Simple chooser option
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, choice time t, expiry T, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: chooser value [M]. RUMUS: card Core 6: chooser = C_BS(K,T) + K e^{-rT}N(-y2) - S e^{-qT}N(-y1), y1 = [ln(S/K) + bT + sigma^2 t/2]/(sigma sqrt t), y2 = y1 - sigma sqrt t (equivalently call(T) + put with strike K e^{-(r-q)(T-t)} and life t, scaled e^{-q(T-t)}); toolkit chooser_simple_price(S,K,t_choose,T,r,sigma,q). JAWAB: 1) y1, y2 [M]. 2) chooser [M]. 3) check >= max(C, P); t -> 0 gives max(C,P), t = T gives straddle. 4) write.
formulas: chooser = C(K,T) + K e^{-rT}N(-y2) - S e^{-qT}N(-y1)

title: Complex chooser with different strikes and expiries
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, Kc, Kp, choice t, Tc, Tp, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: complex chooser value [M]. RUMUS: critical I solves C_BS(I, Kc, Tc - t) = P_BS(I, Kp, Tp - t); d1 = [ln(S/I) + (b + sigma^2/2)t]/(sigma sqrt t); y1 = [ln(S/Kc) + (b + sigma^2/2)Tc]/(sigma sqrt Tc), y2 on Kp, Tp; rho1 = sqrt(t/Tc), rho2 = sqrt(t/Tp); V = S e^{-qTc}M(d1,y1;rho1) - Kc e^{-rTc}M(d2,y1 - sigma sqrt Tc;rho1) - S e^{-qTp}M(-d1,-y2;rho2) + Kp e^{-rTp}M(-d2,-y2 + sigma sqrt Tp;rho2); toolkit chooser_complex_price. JAWAB: 1) root I. 2) bivariate terms. 3) V [M]. 4) check Kc = Kp, Tc = Tp -> simple chooser. 5) write.

title: Margrabe exchange option
frame: DIKETAHUI: S1, S2, T, sigma1, sigma2, rho, q1, q2 [M] (r not needed). DITANYAKAN: value of max(S1_T - S2_T, 0) [M]. RUMUS: card Core 7: s = sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2 - 2 rho s1 s2); d1 = [ln(S1 e^{-q1T}/(S2 e^{-q2T})) + s^2T/2]/(s sqrt T), d2 = d1 - s sqrt T; V = S1 e^{-q1T}N(d1) - S2 e^{-q2T}N(d2); toolkit margrabe_price(S1,S2,T,sigma1,sigma2,rho,q1,q2). JAWAB: 1) s [M]. 2) d1, d2. 3) V [M]. 4) check V >= max(S1 e^{-q1T} - S2 e^{-q2T}, 0); V falls with rho. 5) write.
formulas: s = sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2 - 2 rho s1 s2)
pitfalls: discounting with r: the exchange option is r-free

title: Exchange option sensitivity to correlation
frame: DIKETAHUI: S1, S2, T, sigma1, sigma2, q1, q2; grid of correlations rho [R] in (-1, 1). DITANYAKAN: Margrabe price per rho [R]; correlation vega dV/drho. RUMUS: s(rho) = sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2 - 2 rho s1 s2); V(rho) from margrabe_price; dV/drho = dV/ds x ds/drho = [S1 e^{-q1T} n(d1) sqrt T] x (-s1 s2/s). JAWAB: 1) loop rho [R]. 2) price, s [R]. 3) analytic dV/drho [R] and central-difference check. 4) monotone decreasing check; rho = 1, s1 = s2 -> intrinsic of forwards. 5) write.
formulas: dV/drho = -S1 e^{-q1T} n(d1) sqrt(T) s1 s2/s

title: Kirk spread option approximation
frame: DIKETAHUI: F1, F2 (or S1, S2 with q1, q2), K, T, r, sigma1, sigma2, rho [M]. DITANYAKAN: spread call (or put) value [M]. RUMUS: card Core 7: F_i = S_i e^{(r - q_i)T} if spots; w = F2/(F2 + K); s_K = sqrt(s1^2 - 2 rho s1 s2 w + s2^2 w^2); d1 = [ln(F1/(F2+K)) + s_K^2 T/2]/(s_K sqrt T), d2 = d1 - s_K sqrt T; call = e^{-rT}[F1 N(d1) - (F2+K) N(d2)]; toolkit kirk_spread_price(F1,F2,K,T,r,sigma1,sigma2,rho,kind), kirk_spread_price_spot. JAWAB: 1) forwards. 2) s_K. 3) price [M]. 4) check K = 0 equals margrabe_price. 5) put via parity e^{-rT}(F1 - F2 - K). 6) write.
formulas: s_K = sqrt(s1^2 - 2 rho s1 s2 w + s2^2 w^2)
pitfalls: Kirk inaccurate for large K/F2 or negative K

title: Spread option Monte Carlo with correlated GBMs vs Kirk
deliverables: summary json: kirk_price, mc_price, standard_error, kirk_error_in_se
frame: DIKETAHUI: S1, S2, K, T, r, q1, q2, sigma1, sigma2, rho; n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC spread price, SE; Kirk bias. RUMUS: Z1, Z2 iid; W2 = rho Z1 + sqrt(1 - rho^2) Z2; S_iT = S_i exp((r - q_i - s_i^2/2)T + s_i sqrt T W_i); payoff max(S1_T - S2_T - K, 0); SE ddof=1; toolkit kirk_spread_price_spot. JAWAB: 1) rng seeded, Z [n_paths x 2]. 2) correlate. 3) terminal prices. 4) price, SE. 5) (kirk - mc)/SE. 6) K = 0 -> margrabe check. 7) write.
formulas: W2 = rho Z1 + sqrt(1 - rho^2) Z2

title: Variance swap fair strike from option strip (Carr-Madan / DDKZ)
deliverables: summary json: k_var, k_vol (decimal), forward, n_strikes
per-strike table: K, Q, dK, contribution
frame: DIKETAHUI: option quotes for one expiry [n_K] (strike, call mid, put mid), r, T, S or F. DITANYAKAN: fair variance K_var (annual), vol strike sqrt(K_var). RUMUS: card Core 8: F from parity (strike min |C - P|: F = K + e^{rT}(C - P)); Q(K) = put if K < F else call; dK_i = (K_{i+1} - K_{i-1})/2 interior, one-sided at ends; K_var = (2 e^{rT}/T) sum dK_i Q_i/K_i^2. JAWAB: 1) sort strikes, drop zero bids if told. 2) F. 3) OTM Q [n_K]. 4) dK on the filtered grid. 5) contributions, K_var, K_vol. 6) write.
pitfalls: dK computed before filtering strikes

title: VIX-style index with K0 correction term
frame: DIKETAHUI: near and next expiry strips (strike, bid, ask call/put), r per expiry, minutes/years to expiry T1, T2. DITANYAKAN: sigma^2 per term and VIX (index points). RUMUS: card Core 8: F = K* + e^{rT}(C - P) at min |C - P|; K0 = first strike <= F; sigma^2 = (2/T) sum dK/K^2 e^{rT} Q(K) - (1/T)(F/K0 - 1)^2; Q at K0 = average of put and call; drop strikes after two consecutive zero bids; VIX = 100 sqrt{[T1 s1^2 (N2 - N30)/(N2 - N1) + T2 s2^2 (N30 - N1)/(N2 - N1)] x N365/N30}. JAWAB: 1) F, K0 per term. 2) filter. 3) sigma^2 per term. 4) interpolate to 30 days. 5) write.
pitfalls: K0 term only when the task asks for the VIX methodology

title: Variance swap P&L and vega notional
frame: DIKETAHUI: price series [n+1], strike K_vol (vol points or decimal), vega notional N_vega (or variance notional). DITANYAKAN: realized variance, payoff to long (currency). RUMUS: card Core 8: sigma_R^2 = (252/n) sum ln^2(S_i/S_{i-1}) (no demeaning); N_var = N_vega/(2 K_vol); payoff = N_var(sigma_R^2 - K_vol^2); in vol-point units consistent: K_vol and sigma_R both x100 if N_vega per vol point. JAWAB: 1) log returns [n]. 2) sigma_R^2. 3) N_var. 4) payoff. 5) compare vol-swap-like approx N_vega(sigma_R - K_vol). 6) write.
pitfalls: demeaning returns; mixing percent and decimal units

title: Variance swap mark-to-market midlife
frame: DIKETAHUI: strike K_var, variance notional N_var, elapsed t, maturity T, realized var to date sigma_{0,t}^2, current fair variance for remaining period K_{t,T} (from strip), r. DITANYAKAN: MTM of long variance swap (currency). RUMUS: expected total var = (t/T) sigma_{0,t}^2 + ((T - t)/T) K_{t,T}; MTM = N_var e^{-r(T-t)}[expected total var - K_var]. JAWAB: 1) realized var to date with 252 annualisation. 2) K_{t,T} via strip formula on remaining T - t. 3) blend. 4) discount. 5) write.

title: Variance swap strike from flat or lognormal model and convexity vs vol swap
frame: DIKETAHUI: either flat sigma or strip; optional variance-of-variance estimate Var(V). DITANYAKAN: fair var strike, vol strike, convexity gap. RUMUS: flat BS world: K_var = sigma^2 exactly (strip with BS prices reproduces it); vol swap K_vol ~ sqrt(K_var) - Var(V)/(8 K_var^{3/2}) (Brockhaus-Long). JAWAB: 1) K_var from strip or sigma^2. 2) check strip on BS prices recovers sigma^2 (truncation error from finite range). 3) vol swap approx. 4) report sqrt(K_var) >= K_vol. 5) write.

title: Digital and barrier prices on a strike/barrier grid table
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, T, r, q, sigma; strike grid K [n_K], barrier grid H [n_H], product kind. DITANYAKAN: price matrix [n_H x n_K] (currency). RUMUS: barrier_price / digital_price per cell; KO price increases as a down barrier moves away from S (lower H); KI decreases. JAWAB: 1) build meshgrid. 2) evaluate closed form per cell (skip invalid side: H >= S for down). 3) companion vanilla [n_K]. 4) checks: KO <= vanilla, monotone in H, H -> 0 gives vanilla. 5) write long-format table (H, K, price).

title: Exotic book revaluation: mixed product per-contract table
frame: DIKETAHUI: contracts [M] each with product label (digital, barrier, asian, lookback, compound, chooser, exchange, spread), parameters, position size. DITANYAKAN: price per contract [M], position value, book total (currency). RUMUS: dispatch to toolkit: digital_price, barrier_price, asian_geometric_price / asian_arithmetic_levy, lookback_floating_price / lookback_fixed_price, compound_option_price, chooser_simple_price, margrabe_price, kirk_spread_price. JAWAB: 1) normalise labels, units (percent -> decimal, days -> years). 2) dispatch per row. 3) value x quantity. 4) per-product identity checks (KI + KO, parity). 5) total. 6) write.
pitfalls: silently defaulting unknown labels

title: Barrier option under discrete dividends or cost of carry b variants
frame: DIKETAHUI: contracts [M] on stock (b = r - q), futures (b = 0), FX (b = r_d - r_f); barrier parameters. DITANYAKAN: price [M]. RUMUS: card Core 2 with generalized carry b: S e^{(b-r)T} factors; mu = (b - sigma^2/2)/sigma^2; lam uses r. Toolkit barrier_price with q = r - b. JAWAB: 1) map underlying type to b and q = r - b. 2) terms A..F. 3) price [M]. 4) check b = r case equals no-dividend stock. 5) write.
formulas: futures: b = 0; FX: b = r_d - r_f

title: Exotic option Monte Carlo pricing engine with common draws across strikes
deliverables: per-contract table: mc_price, standard_error, closed_form, z
frame: DIKETAHUI: product spec (path-dependent), strikes [M], S, T, r, q, sigma; n_paths, n_steps, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC price and SE per strike [M]; z-scores vs closed form. RUMUS: one call gbm_paths(S, r - q, sigma, T, n_steps, n_paths, seed) -> [n_paths x n_steps+1]; payoff matrix [n_paths x M] via broadcasting; price = e^{-rT} mean over axis 0; SE = std(ddof=1, axis 0)/sqrt N. JAWAB: 1) simulate once. 2) path statistic (avg, max, min, hit flag) [n_paths]. 3) payoff [n_paths x M]. 4) price, SE [M]. 5) z vs closed form, agree if |z| <= 3. 6) write.
pitfalls: re-seeding per strike breaks monotonic smooth curves

title: Power or squared payoff digital-type option
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, power n (asymmetric: max(S_T^n - K, 0)), T, r, q, sigma [M]. DITANYAKAN: price [M]. RUMUS: S_T^n lognormal with E[S_T^n] = S^n exp(n(r - q - sigma^2/2)T + n^2 sigma^2 T/2); call = e^{-rT}[E[S^n] N(d1) - K N(d2)], d2 = [ln(S^n/K) + n(r - q - sigma^2/2)T]/(n sigma sqrt T), d1 = d2 + n sigma sqrt T. JAWAB: 1) moment. 2) d1, d2 [M]. 3) price. 4) MC check with same Z. 5) n = 1 -> bs_price. 6) write.
formulas: E[S_T^n] = S^n exp(n(b - s^2/2)T + n^2 s^2 T/2)

title: Asian option Greeks by bump with common random numbers
deliverables: per-contract table: delta, gamma, vega (analytic approx and MC)
frame: DIKETAHUI: S, K, T, r, q, sigma, n fixings [M]; bump h. DITANYAKAN: Asian delta, gamma, vega [M]. RUMUS: central bumps on asian_arithmetic_levy or asian_geometric_price (deterministic); MC version re-uses identical Z for up/down legs; delta = (V(S+h) - V(S-h))/2h. JAWAB: 1) h = 1% S, 1% sigma. 2) bumped prices [M]. 3) Greeks [M]. 4) check Asian ATM delta < European delta; vega < European vega. 5) write.

title: Lookback vs vanilla vs barrier ordering checks
